task: NFL-004 B — anytime-touchdown scorer inside the coherent game worlds (World Model V2)
why: nfl-game-worlds-v1's world ATD failed (test window 2019-21: log loss 0.5138 vs rzTdV1 0.5109, ECE 0.034). Diagnosis on development seasons 2022-25 (reports/nfl-005-game-worlds-td-diagnosis.json, no refit): the scorer-eligibility gate double-counts opportunity; touch rates from the Dirichlet allocation are too low; the non-offensive 'other' TD term is missing; the OTHER bucket takes too many TDs.
evaluationWindow: FORWARD ONLY. Both historical windows (development 2022-25 and test 2019-21) have now been examined for the world TD scorer, so no historical look can confer eligibility. Evidence comes from 2026 regular-season games kicking off AFTER this registration, captured before kickoff by the World Model V2 pipeline and graded against official box scores.

candidate.scorerSelection: For each offensive TD in a world, the scorer is drawn with weight proportional to the player's opportunities IN THAT WORLD times his shrunk touchdown rate per opportunity: rushing TD weight = carries_w(i) x rzCarryRate(i); receiving TD weight = receptions_w(i) x rzRecRate(i), where rzCarryRate = (rz carry share / overall carry share) shrunk toward 1 with k = 40 (the NFL-004 development selection), rzRecRate likewise for targets. A player with zero world opportunities has zero weight because his weight is zero, not because of a separate gate; shares are NOT renormalised over eligible players.
candidate.touchRates: unchanged Dirichlet kappas (allocation is NFL-003/005's, frozen); the candidate does not retune allocation.
candidate.otherTd: add the non-offensive per-player-game term otherTdPerPlayerGame from the P301 warm-up (0.003) as an independent Bernoulli per active skill player, outside the team TD count (it is a defensive/special-teams score of the player's own team only when nonOffTd > 0 in that world; otherwise not credited).
candidate.probability: P(anytime TD) = share of worlds in which the player is credited >= 1 rushing or receiving TD (thrown TDs never count).

comparators: the published opportunity touchdown model (player board) — the incumbent public ATD
rows: every player-game the candidate publishes with P(anytime) on a game whose kickoff is after its capture; void if the player has no box-score line (did not play); the same rows for every model

decisionRule.eligibleForDisplayUnderForwardEvaluation: only after n >= 1000 forward rows AND log loss <= min(rzTdV1, incumbent) + 0.000 AND ECE <= 0.03 AND level in [0.95, 1.05]
decisionRule.otherwise: stays private; world TD marginals remain unpublished

notChanged: published anytime-TD source (player board) stays the public source until this rule is met
